title: The set is editable
blurb: Four changes built the derivation of a competitive set and left the rest of the sentence unbuilt: COMPETITIVE_DISCOVERY §5.5 says the set is directly editable. A reader can now remove a company, add one, and run the corrected set — as a new analysis with its own permalink, so the report being corrected stays readable. The button hands back a whole prompt, exactly as a clarifying chip does, because origins_in already owns what counts as a company and a second copy of that rule in TypeScript would be a rule that agrees today. And keeping the reader’s edits in step with a changing report turned out to be dead code: the set is only offered once a run is over, and correcting it starts another one.
